headline: From energy costs to the CAP, farmers take to the square at Montecitorio: Cia Romagna at the October 14 sit-in
summary: Farmers are mobilising for five days against rising energy costs, supply chain price increases and CAP policies. Farm-gate prices do not cover production costs, according to the report.
why: Italian agriculture depends on energy and inputs, and the EU Common Agricultural Policy sets subsidies that shape farm incomes across the bloc.
